definitions.explanation: Hand-held cutting shears used to prune branches, stems, and twigs in gardening. From {剪定|せんてい} (pruning) + はさみ (scissors), with rendaku turning はさみ into ばさみ.

examples.japanese: {剪定|せんてい}ばさみで{枝|えだ}を{切|き}った。
examples.english: I cut the branch with pruning shears.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}{仕事|しごと}には{剪定|せんてい}ばさみが{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: Pruning shears are indispensable for gardening work.

examples.japanese: {切|き}れ{味|あじ}のいい{剪定|せんてい}ばさみを{使|つか}うと、{木|き}を{傷|いた}めにくい。
examples.english: Using sharp pruning shears makes it less likely to damage the tree.

notes:
A gardening tool for cutting branches and stems. Compound of {剪定|せんてい} (pruning) + はさみ (scissors); the は voices to ば by rendaku.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {剪定|せんてい}ばさみで{切|き}る: to cut with pruning shears
- {剪定|せんてい}ばさみを{研|と}ぐ: to sharpen the pruning shears

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {植木|うえき}ばさみ: garden/topiary shears — broader term for shears used on garden plants
- ハサミ: scissors — general-purpose, not for woody branches
